about_the_game:
Reya's Garden World Adventure

A casual 2D clearance game featuring VTuber "Reya Ostereich" - a colossal dragon girl - and her companions in a miniature-scale adventure.

Since we are a very small team of only two people, the game might indeed have some issues. ​​Before purchasing the game officially, it is crucial that you check the following information:​​

  • ​​Not being able to click on the character selection screen is NOT a bug; you need to press A or D on your keyboard to navigate.​​

  • ​​To trigger CGs (special images) within the game:​​

    • Play Levels 1 and 2 with ​​Rayah​​.

    • Play Levels 3 and 4 with ​​a character unlocked later​​.

    • And so on and so forth.

    • After each of the five characters has played two levels, if there are more levels, play them with ​​Claire​​.

      (This is basically because we honestly had no idea how to implement a character-unlock system tied to progression).

  • ​​The dragging maneuver is performed by holding down the Spacebar and then pressing A or D.​​

  • ​​CGs are stored in the game's root directory.​​ If you absolutely cannot get the game to run properly:

    • You can view the CGs directly in the root folder – they are the original image files.

    • You are eligible for a refund.

    • Alternatively, you can consider it buying the CGs with a free game attached, as the game has no anti-piracy measures (and we certainly don't know how to implement them).

  • If you encounter minor issues, try restarting the game.

Story Premise

The vile Goblin Legion has invaded a neighboring kingdom of the Austerich Dragon Empire, seizing its facilities. Now they’re transforming human towns into military footholds!

Put a stop to their expansion!

Play as Ostereich’s giant dragon girl: harness your world-shattering power to stomp flat every annoying goblin and shatter occupied structures before they become tools of destruction!

Game Features

Exclusive Giantess Art Collection

Unlock 11 stunning illustrations showcasing the unique moe appeal of colossal maidens!

Alternate Playable Characters

Take control of other VTubers and freely crush & trample your way through Garden World!

Perfect for Giantess Enthusiasts.
